tools.name: request_tutor
tools.description: Submit a request for TutorPing to match a student with a tutor, when search_tutors finds no fit or the user prefers to be matched. TutorPing replies by email within 1 business day with tutor options. Collect what the student needs, then confirm the details AND get the user's explicit agreement that

tools.name: get_tutor
tools.description: Full public profile for one TutorPing tutor (by slug from search_tutors).

tools.name: get_tutor_availability
tools.description: Open session times for a tutor, in the tutor's timezone. Use before request_booking.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Book a student into one of a tutor's open slots (from get_tutor_availability). The tutor and the student both get a confirmation email. Confirm the time, name, and email with the user before calling.

tools.name: tutoring_demand
tools.description: How many people online recently asked for a tutor in a subject (from Reddit and other communities TutorPing monitors), in total. Useful for tutors deciding whether there is demand for their subject. The requests themselves are only shared with TutorPing tutors.

tools.name: ask_tutorping
tools.description: Ask anything about TutorPing, finding a tutor, or finding tutoring students that the other tools don't cover, in plain words. Returns which TutorPing tool or page fits, plus contact details. Do not include personal information.

tools.name: how_to_get_leads
tools.description: Explains how a tutor gets student leads from TutorPing and connects their own AI assistant.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_tutor" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tutors, request_tutor, request_booking · Private data: request_tutor, ask_tutorping · Public sink: request_tutor, request_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tutors, request_tutor, request_booking · Private data: request_tutor, ask_tutorping · Public sink: request_tutor, request_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
